posts.title: The AI Instruction Files That Hijack Coding Agents
posts.description: How malicious AI instruction files access credentials, propagate through agent outputs, and compromise CI/CD pipelines without executing a single shell command.

posts.title: Algorithmic Anxiety and AI Safety Filters
posts.description: AI safety filters refuse work they read as harmful, even your own. Experts learn to soften and abstract their content to get it through, trading precision for permission. That habit is algorithmic anxiety, and its cost compounds: the filtered text becomes the data the next models train on.
